title: Burj Al Arab, Jumeirah Group, Dubai (2021)

blocks.text: Migration & Upgrade of Existing Pool Control to Simatic WinCC

items: Existing control system (Honeywell, Wago) is defective and allowing manual control only.
No automatic function for filter backwash and filter pumps (duty and standby).
50% of all sensors are defective and/or providing inconsistent readings.
Actual controller provided by HMI panels with limited functionality and no SCADA integration.
